prBodyNotes: **Vendored asset — manual file refresh required.** Renovate only bumps the version string recorded in `README.md`; it does **not** replace the binary/asset files. After merging you must download the new upstream files, replace the vendored copies (see per-asset path below), and re-run the tests.
Replace `internal/web/static/js/htmx-v{{{newVersion}}}.min.js` (delete the old `htmx-v*.min.js`) and update the version comment in `internal/web/static/static.go`.

Re-subset the font at `{{{newVersion}}}` and replace `internal/web/static/fonts/SpaceGrotesk-{Regular,Medium,Bold}-{{{newVersion}}}.woff2`, then update the version comment in `internal/web/static/static.go`.
Re-extract the inlined SVG subset from lucide-static `{{{newVersion}}}` into `internal/web/icons/svg/` and bump `Version` in `internal/web/icons/icons.go`.

customManagers.description: Track hand-vendored htmx and Space Grotesk versions recorded in the README asset table (github-tags).

Track the vendored lucide-static release recorded in the README asset table (npm). The recorded version is the lucide-static package version, so npm is the correct datasource even though the Source column links the GitHub project.
